messages:
Asha Rao: Quick thread 1: capture a minimalist rules-of-engagement for SI co-sell leads that originate from cloud marketplaces or hardware referrals. Need: claim window, how to stitch accounts, and joint-announce gating. Keep it lightweight.
Tom Nguyen: +1. propose single-claim window: 48h for most leads, 96h for marketplace-sourced since they tend to warm slower.
Priya Singh: For marketplace leads can we require an initial outreach (email or calendar) within 24h to keep claim active? otherwise it auto-reverts.
Evan Lee: agree on 24h first-touch. also dedupe step: canonicalize domain + marketplace_account_id before creating claim. we already have `mapping.marketplace_id -> crm.external_id`.
Maya Ortiz: legal/marketing note: any joint listing or co-branded marketplace tile requires signed co-marketing addendum + logo asset approval. no exceptions for public listings.
Asha Rao: good. account stitching fallback: if dedupe ambiguous, ops tags `stitch-review` and sales-ops resolves within 48h. record resolution reason in CRM.
Tom Nguyen: tie-breaker if two partners claim same lead simultaneously? first-claim wins; if same-second granularity then higher engagement_score (meeting > demo > doc view). still tie -> ops adjudication.
Priya Singh: add enterprise carve: ARR>1.5M default to Redwood AE unless partner has explicit carve documented in MOU.
Evan Lee: telemetry needed: abandoned_claim_rate, avg_time_to_first_contact, claim_conflict_rate. marketplace-bot can push daily summary to #partnerships-dashboard.
marketplace-bot: Report queued: marketplace_claims_today=12, abandoned_claims=2, avg_first_touch_hours=18
Maya Ortiz: I'll draft the 1-pager for partners and the checklist for marketplace tiles. tagging legal for co-marketing addendum.
Asha Rao: action items: Maya draft checklist, Evan add dedupe script to nightly job, Tom run a 30-lead pilot with 48/96h windows, Priya coordinate AE carve list. target: pilot start Mon. Thanks folks :rocket:
